demands.title: Onboard existing codebases into evidence-backed project memory
demands.summary: Add a research-first bootstrap path that converts repository evidence into reviewable Whyloom proposals while preserving the lightweight ongoing feedback loop.
demands.outcome: An agent can analyze an existing repository, map its implementation, and propose evidence-backed project reasoning for human review without treating inference as truth.

demands.title: Install Whyloom and its skills with one command
demands.summary: Remove adoption friction through bundled skills, a cross-platform installer, Copilot-native paths, and trusted PyPI release automation.
demands.outcome: Users can install Whyloom from PyPI and safely register its skills for Codex, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or generic Agent Skills without manually copying files.

demands.title: Onboard existing codebases without a bootstrap prompt
demands.source: User requested that bootstrap intent be injected into Whyloom instead of requiring a manual agent prompt.
demands.summary: Turn repository bootstrap into a discoverable one-command command-and-skill workflow.
demands.outcome: A single whyloom onboard command prepares evidence and a pending agent task that installed Whyloom skills detect and complete safely.

requirements.statement: Collect bounded evidence from source code, tests, configuration, documentation, dependency manifests, and local Git history.
acceptance: A bootstrap run emits a deterministic manifest that identifies evidence by kind and source locator without copying sensitive repository contents wholesale.

required_evidence: Automated fixture test covering every supported evidence class.

requirements.statement: Represent inferred project reasoning as proposals with explicit confidence and evidence references.

required_evidence: Schema and indexing tests for proposed inference metadata.

requirements.statement: Produce an actionable bootstrap report for human or agent review.

required_evidence: CLI integration test and dogfood report.

requirements.statement: Provide a portable whyloom-bootstrap skill for Claude Code and Codex-style agents.
acceptance: and report steps and requires evidence-backed human review.

required_evidence: Skill validator passes and skill instructions are exercised against Whyloom.

requirements.statement: Preserve Whyloom production safety and deterministic behavior.
acceptance: generated bootstrap artifacts stay outside canonical records
and invalid records cannot partially update the graph.

requirements.statement: Install and uninstall bundled Whyloom skills safely across supported assistant platforms.
acceptance: The CLI supports global and project installation for Codex
and generic Agent Skills; it is idempotent and never overwrites unowned skill directories.

required_evidence: Installer unit and CLI integration tests.

requirements.statement: Support official GitHub Copilot Agent Skills locations.
acceptance: Copilot installs use .github/skills for projects and ~/.copilot/skills for users
and both Whyloom skills validate after installation.

required_evidence: Copilot-specific path and installed-skill validation tests.

requirements.statement: Ship skill resources inside the Python distribution.
acceptance: Built wheels contain both skills and an installed CLI can locate them without repository access.

required_evidence: Wheel content inspection and installed-resource test.

requirements.statement: Prepare secure PyPI publishing and simple installation documentation.
acceptance: A release workflow uses PyPI Trusted Publishing
and README documents uv tool install whyloom plus skill registration.

requirements.statement: Onboard an uninitialized existing repository with one idempotent command.
acceptance: and writes a machine-readable pending request without inventing canonical reasoning.

required_evidence: Automated CLI and lifecycle tests pass.

requirements.statement: Expose and safely complete the onboarding lifecycle.
acceptance: Index and onboarding status expose pending work; completion requires valid records
and preserves a reviewable completion result.

requirements.statement: Make installed Whyloom skills consume pending onboarding automatically.
acceptance: The regular and bootstrap skills check the pending request
and complete onboarding without requiring the user to know a bootstrap prompt.

required_evidence: Both skills validate and their instructions cover the full pending-request workflow.

requirements.statement: Ship and document the onboarding workflow as a tested release.
acceptance: and existing-codebase dogfood all reflect whyloom onboard.

nodes.title: Add bootstrap evidence and proposal metadata model

required: Focused model, parser, and indexing tests pass.

nodes.title: Implement repository evidence collection and bootstrap report

required: Fixture integration test proves bounded evidence coverage and report generation.

nodes.title: Expose bootstrap through the Whyloom CLI

required: CLI tests cover human and JSON output without mutating canonical records.
Skill quick validation passes and instructions enforce proposal-only inference.

nodes.title: Dogfood bootstrap and complete production validation

required: Dogfood report, full tests, lint, package build, and doctor all pass.
Installer and CLI tests pass for global, project, conflict, update, and uninstall flows.
Wheel contains both complete skill directories and runtime discovery succeeds.

nodes.title: Add trusted PyPI release workflow and metadata

required: Build succeeds and release workflow declares OIDC permissions and PyPI publish action.
Full tests, lint, build, skill validation, installer dogfood, and documentation checks pass.

nodes.title: Implement onboard command and pending request lifecycle

required: Onboarding CLI and lifecycle tests pass.

nodes.title: Teach Whyloom skills to complete pending onboarding

required: Both portable skills validate and describe pending request handling.

nodes.title: Document dogfood and release onboarding workflow

required: Full tests, lint, build, wheel checks, skill validation, and existing-codebase dogfood pass.
